Name: Open water
Description: A pond's open water heard from its whole surface (ShoreSpec.OpenPond, ShoreSynth): in a stiff wind its short sea breaks in small whitecaps where the fetch is long enough for a crest to fold air under, more to leeward and where a gust is crossing. Its line is the water's outline; the surface inside it is cut at the listener and each piece plays the crests breaking in it. Silent under 3 m/s. Not a recording and not a loop.
